facts.rationale: Corrects the displayed-endpoint error and preserves initialization and transition behavior.
facts.value: Before posing, options outside 0x1B..0x1E reset xE above 119 to 90; options inside that interval reset xE above 159 to 130. The resulting frame is applied, then xE increments. Eventual displayed cycles are 90..119 and 130..159; stored 120/160 are reset before display. There is no lower-bound clamp or reset merely on option change. Scene setup initializes xE to 80, allowing an initial or cross-option transient below the eventual loop start.

facts.rationale: Distinguishes animation bounds, selection state, auxiliary values, and persistent fields.
facts.value: Plays a match-type-dependent entry sound only if x2C is zero, then clears x2C unconditionally. After presentation construction, initializes scene counters x0/x4/xF to zero and xE to 80. For indices below x30 it clears x18, x6, x10 and animation a/b/completion/loop/state, sets animation end c to 30, and auxiliary x38 to 6. The 30 is an animation end frame, not a separate delay; selection state begins at 0, not 6. This is selective initialization and does not reset x1C.

facts.rationale: Preserves the actual result-key, identity, and character-domain distinctions rather than repairing them semantically.
facts.value: The Results caller copies match_end to gm_80477738 before invoking this routine for nonzero Tournament match types. The routine collects fn_80166CBC standings values, stably sorts results[] while carrying indices.values[], and conditionally reads/writes handicap through xF-position lookups keyed by sorted results[i], not by the parallel player identities. Rotation instead uses indices.values[] to reassign xE positions. Active x4B8 fields are rebuilt through xE-position lookups. Finally the audio mask starts at 8 and incorporates lbAudioAx_80026E84 calls using raw x4B8[k].x1 cast to CharacterKind; unlike scene entry, this path does not call fn_8018F6FC first.

facts.rationale: Retains verified rotation while making the handicap indexing ambiguity and fallback explicit.
facts.value: The external Results caller bypasses this routine for match_type 0 and selects state 1; nonzero types invoke it and then select state 2. The routine sorts standings ascending, swapping only on greater-than. Handicap rule 1 enables read-adjust-write using sorted result values as xF lookup keys. For match_type 1, replacement uses indices.values[i]; otherwise it uses indices.values[(x30-1)-i]. Replaced entrants move to tail positions, waiting entrants inherit vacated active positions, and later positions decrease by hmn_cpu_count. Both xE/xF lookup helpers return entrant zero on failure. No local bounds or key-validity validation establishes that result values are interchangeable with player identities.

facts.rationale: Separates animation frame position from elapsed time, transition request from teardown, and eligible input processing from all-ready processing.
facts.value: The immediate menu-exit branch plays the back sound, calls menu/scene transition helpers, requests GM_MENU, and returns; it does not directly free archives. Readiness requires state 2, current animation frame b>=60, and controller error zero. If every configured player qualifies, x0 increments and at >=30 commits xF=xE for all entrants and calls fn_801965C4. Otherwise x0 resets and only connected players process input. Held B increments a per-player counter and aborts to state 0 after >90; its release reset occurs only on this eligible path. Character and special-selection edits exclude states 1/2. A/Start enters state 1 unless already state 2; B changes state 2 to 3; X/Y adjust bounded color only in editable states. The non-all-ready path builds and submits a preload summary unless an earlier exit returns.
